answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to capital assets, effectively raising the cost of identity replication. An attacker cannot simply harvest a timber of virtual accounts to gain control; instead, they must acquire expensive hardware or digital cedar tokens. By requiring economic skin in the game, the system makes mass spoofing as unlikely as a random sonnet emerging from noise, forcing adversaries to bear the financial burden of lost interest.
